charm.actions-yaml:
create-backup:
  description: Creates a backup to s3 storage in AWS.
  params:
    type:
      description: The backup type, the default value is 'full'. Full backup is a
        full copy of all data. Differential backup is a copy only of changed data
        since the last full backup. Incremental backup is a copy only of changed data
        since the last backup (any type). Possible values - full, differential, incremental.
      type: string
create-replication:
  description: Set up asynchronous replication between two clusters.
  params:
    name:
      default: default
      description: The name of the replication (defaults to 'default').
      type: string
get-password:
  description: Get a charm system user's password. Useful for manual troubleshooting
    and for backing up cluster credentials. It cannot be used for application integration
    relations.
  params:
    username:
      description: The username, the default value 'operator'. Possible values - backup,
        operator, replication, rewind, patroni.
      type: string
get-primary:
  description: Get the unit with is the primary/leader in the replication.
list-backups:
  description: Lists backups in s3 storage in AWS.
pre-upgrade-check:
  description: Run necessary pre-upgrade checks and preparations before executing
    a charm refresh.
promote-to-primary:
  description: Promotes the cluster of choice to a primary cluster. Must be ran against
    the leader unit when promoting a cluster or against the unit to be promoted within
    the cluster.
  params:
    force:
      description: Force the promotion of a cluster when there is already a primary
        cluster.
      type: boolean
    scope:
      description: Whether to promote a unit or a cluster. Must be set to either unit
        or cluster.
      type: string
restore:
  description: Restore a database backup using pgBackRest. S3 credentials are retrieved
    from a relation with the S3 integrator charm.
  params:
    backup-id:
      description: A backup-id to identify the backup to restore (format = %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
      type: string
    restore-to-time:
      description: Point-in-time-recovery target in PSQL format.
      type: string
resume-upgrade:
  description: Resume a rolling upgrade after asserting successful upgrade of a new
    revision.
set-password:
  description: Change the system user's password, which is used by charm. It is for
    internal charm users and SHOULD NOT be used by applications.
  params:
    password:
      description: The password will be auto-generated if this option is not specified.
      type: string
    username:
      description: The username, the default value 'operator'. Possible values - backup,
        operator, replication rewind.
      type: string
set-tls-private-key:
  description: Set the private key, which will be used for certificate signing requests
    (CSR). Run for each unit separately.
  params:
    private-key:
      description: The content of private key for communications with clients. Content
        will be auto-generated if this option is not specified.
      type: string
charm.config-yaml:
options:
  connection_authentication_timeout:
    default: 60
    description: 'Sets the maximum allowed time to complete client authentication.

      Allowed values are: from 1 to 600.

      '
    type: int
  connection_statement_timeout:
    default: 0
    description: 'Sets the maximum allowed duration of any statement.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  cpu_max_logical_replication_workers:
    default: auto
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of logical replication workers. Should be
      either "auto"

      or a positive integer value. Restart is required when changed.

      auto = max_worker_processes.

      '
    type: string
  cpu_max_parallel_maintenance_workers:
    default: auto
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of workers that can be used for parallel
      maintenance operations

      like CREATE INDEX. Should be either "auto" or a positive integer value.

      Cannot exceed max_parallel_workers.

      auto = max_worker_processes.

      '
    type: string
  cpu_max_parallel_workers:
    default: auto
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of workers that can be used for parallel
      operations.

      Should be either "auto" or a positive integer value. Cannot exceed max_worker_processes.

      auto = max_worker_processes.

      '
    type: string
  cpu_max_sync_workers_per_subscription:
    default: auto
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of synchronization workers per subscription.

      Should be either "auto" or a positive integer value.

      auto = max_worker_processes.

      '
    type: string
  cpu_max_worker_processes:
    default: auto
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of background processes that the system
      can support.

      Should be either "auto" or a positive integer value.

      auto = minimum(8, 2 * vCores). Value will be capped at 10 * vCores if exceeded.

      Restart is required when changed.

      '
    type: string
  cpu_parallel_leader_participation:
    default: true
    description: 'Controls whether Gather and Gather Merge also run subplans.

      '
    type: boolean
  cpu_wal_compression:
    default: true
    description: 'Enable compression of full-page writes written in WAL. Compression
      reduces

      the I/O needed for local storage and replication.

      Default is on (true).

      '
    type: boolean
  durability_maximum_lag_on_failover:
    default: 1048576
    description: 'The amount of transactions that can be lost in bytes to consider
      failover is safe.

      Default is 1048576.

      '
    type: int
  durability_synchronous_commit:
    default: 'on'
    description: "Sets the current transactions synchronization level. This charm\
      \ allows only the\n\u201Con\u201D, \u201Cremote_apply\u201D and \u201Cremote_write\u201D\
      \ values to avoid data loss if the primary\ncrashes and there are replicas.\n"
    type: string
  durability_wal_keep_size:
    default: 4096
    description: 'Sets the minimum size of the WAL file to be kept for the replication.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  experimental_max_connections:
    description: '[EXPERIMENTAL] Force set max_connections.

      '
    type: int
  instance_default_text_search_config:
    default: pg_catalog.simple
    description: "Selects the text search configuration that is used by those variants\
      \ of the text\nsearch functions that do not have an explicit argument specifying\
      \ it.\nAllowed values start with \u201Cpg_catalog.\u201D followed by a language\
      \ name, like\n\u201Cpg_catalog.english\u201D.\n"
    type: string
  instance_max_locks_per_transaction:
    default: 64
    description: 'Specifies the maximum amount of memory to be used by maintenance
      operations,

      such as "VACUUM", "CREATE INDEX", and "ALTER TABLE ADD FOREIGN KEY".

      If this value is specified without units, it is taken as kilobytes.

      Allowed values are: from 64 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  instance_password_encryption:
    default: scram-sha-256
    description: "Determines the algorithm to use to encrypt the password.\nAllowed\
      \ values are: \u201Cmd5\u201D and \u201Cscram-sha-256\u201D.\n"
    type: string
  instance_synchronize_seqscans:
    default: true
    description: 'Enable synchronized sequential scans.

      '
    type: boolean
  ldap_map:
    description: 'List of mapped LDAP group names to PostgreSQL group names, separated
      by commas.

      The map is used to assign LDAP synchronized users to PostgreSQL authorization
      groups.

      Example: <ldap_group_1>=<psql_group_1>,<ldap_group_2>=<psql_group_2>

      '
    type: string
  ldap_search_filter:
    default: (uid=$username)
    description: 'The LDAP search filter to match users with.

      Example: (|(uid=$username)(email=$username))

      '
    type: string
  logging_client_min_messages:
    default: notice
    description: 'Sets the message levels that are sent to the client.

      Allowed values are one of ''debug5'', ''debug4'', ''debug3'', ''debug2'', ''debug1'',
      ''log'', ''notice'', ''warning'' or ''error''.

      Each level includes all the levels that follow it. The later the level, the
      fewer messages are sent.

      '
    type: string
  logging_log_connections:
    default: true
    description: 'Logs each successful connection.

      '
    type: boolean
  logging_log_disconnections:
    default: true
    description: 'Logs end of a session, including duration.

      '
    type: boolean
  logging_log_lock_waits:
    default: false
    description: 'Logs long lock waits.

      '
    type: boolean
  logging_log_min_duration_statement:
    default: -1
    description: 'Sets the minimum running time (milliseconds) above which statements
      will be logged.

      Allowed values are: from -1 to 2147483647 (-1 disables logging

      statement durations).

      '
    type: int
  logging_track_functions:
    default: none
    description: 'Collects function-level statistics on database activity.

      Allowed values are one of ''none'', ''pl'', ''all''.

      Enables tracking of function call counts and time used. Specify pl to track
      only procedural-language functions

      '
    type: string
  memory_maintenance_work_mem:
    default: 65536
    description: 'Sets the maximum memory (KB) to be used for maintenance operations.

      Allowed values are: from 1024 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  memory_max_prepared_transactions:
    default: 0
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of simultaneously prepared transactions.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 262143.

      '
    type: int
  memory_shared_buffers:
    description: 'Sets the number of shared memory buffers (8 kB) used by the server.
      This charm allows

      to set this value up to 40% of the available memory from the unit, as it is
      unlikely

      that an allocation of more than that will work better than a smaller amount.

      Allowed values are: from 16 to 1073741823.

      '
    type: int
  memory_temp_buffers:
    default: 1024
    description: 'Sets the maximum number of temporary buffers (8 kB) used by each
      session.

      Allowed values are: from 100 to 1073741823.

      '
    type: int
  memory_work_mem:
    default: 4096
    description: 'Sets the maximum memory (KB) to be used for query workspaces.

      Allowed values are: from 64 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  optimizer_constraint_exclusion:
    default: partition
    description: "Enables the planner to use constraints to optimize queries.\nAllowed\
      \ values are: \u201Con\u201D, \u201Coff\u201D and \u201Cpartition\u201D.\n"
    type: string
  optimizer_cpu_index_tuple_cost:
    default: 0.005
    description: 'Sets the planner''s estimate of the cost of processing each index

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 1.80E+308.

      '

  optimizer_cpu_operator_cost:

      '
    type: float
  optimizer_cpu_tuple_cost:

      '
    type: float
  optimizer_cursor_tuple_fraction:

      '

  optimizer_default_statistics_target:

      '

  optimizer_enable_async_append:

  optimizer_enable_bitmapscan:

    type: boolean
  request_default_transaction_isolation:
    default: read committed
    description: "Sets the transaction isolation level of each new transaction.\n\
      Allowed values are one of 'serializable', 'repeatable read', 'read committed',\
      \ 'read uncommitted'.\nRead commited or read uncommited is a statement can only\
      \ see rows committed before it began.\nRepeatable read is all statements of\
      \ the current transaction can only see rows committed before \nthe first query\
      \ or data-modification statement was executed in this transaction.\nSerializable\
      \ is all statements of the current transaction can only see rows committed before\
      \ the first \nquery or data-modification statement was executed in this transaction.\n"
    type: string
  request_default_transaction_read_only:
    default: false
    description: 'Sets the default read-only status of new transactions.

      '
    type: boolean
  request_escape_string_warning:
    default: true
    description: 'Warn about backslash escapes in ordinary string literals.

      '
    type: boolean
  request_lock_timeout:
    default: 0
    description: 'Sets the maximum allowed duration of any wait for a lock.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  request_standard_conforming_strings:
    default: true
    description: 'Causes ... strings to treat backslashes literally.

      '
    type: boolean
  request_time_zone:
    default: UTC
    description: 'Sets the time zone for displaying and interpreting time stamps.

      Allowed values are the ones from IANA time zone data, a time zone abbreviation

      like PST and POSIX-style time zone specifications.

      '
    type: string
  request_track_activity_query_size:
    default: 1024
    description: 'Sets the size reserved for pg_stat_activity.query, in bytes.

      Allowed values are: from 100 to 1048576.

      '
    type: int
  request_transform_null_equals:
    default: false
    description: 'Treats "expr=NULL" as "expr IS NULL"

      '
    type: boolean
  request_xmlbinary:
    default: base64
    description: 'Sets how binary values are to be encoded in XML.

      Allowed values are one of ''base64'', ''hex''.

      '
    type: string
  request_xmloption:
    default: content
    description: 'Sets whether XML data in implicit parsing and serialization operations
      is to be considered as documents or content fragments.

      Allowed values are one of ''content'', ''document''.

      '
    type: string
  response_bytea_output:
    default: hex
    description: "Sets the output format for bytes.\nAllowed values are: \u201Cescape\u201D\
      \ and \u201Chex\u201D.\n"
    type: string
  response_exit_on_error:
    default: false
    description: 'Terminate session on any error.

      '
    type: boolean
  response_extra_float_digits:
    default: 1
    description: 'Sets the number of digits displayed for floating-point values.

      Allowed values are: from -15 to 3.

      '
    type: int
  response_gin_fuzzy_search_limit:
    default: 0
    description: 'Sets the maximum allowed result for exact search by GIN.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  response_lc_monetary:
    default: C
    description: 'Sets the locale for formatting monetary amounts.

      Allowed values are the locales available in the unit.

      '
    type: string
  response_lc_numeric:
    default: C
    description: 'Sets the locale for formatting numbers.

      Allowed values are the locales available in the unit.

      '
    type: string
  response_lc_time:
    default: C
    description: 'Sets the locale for formatting date and time values.

      Allowed values are the locales available in the unit.

      '
    type: string
  session_idle_in_transaction_session_timeout:
    default: 0
    description: 'Sets the maximum allowed idle time between queries, when in a transaction.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  storage_bgwriter_lru_maxpages:
    default: 100
    description: 'Background writer maximum number of LRU pages to flush per round.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 1073741823.

      '
    type: int
  storage_bgwriter_lru_multiplier:
    default: 2.0
    description: 'Multiple of the average buffer usage to free per round.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 10.

      '
    type: float
  storage_default_table_access_method:
    default: heap
    description: 'Sets the default table access method for new tables.

      These entries can be created using the CREATE ACCESS METHOD SQL command.

      '
    type: string
  storage_gin_pending_list_limit:
    default: 4096
    description: 'Sets the maximum size of the pending list for GIN index.

      Allowed values are: from 64 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  storage_hot_standby_feedback:
    default: false
    description: 'Send feedback to the primary or upstream standby about queries currently
      executing on

      the standby.

      Warning: enabling can cause database bloat on the Primary for some workloads.

      Default is false.

      '
    type: boolean
  storage_old_snapshot_threshold:
    default: -1
    description: 'Time before a snapshot is too old to read pages changed after the
      snapshot was taken.

      Allowed values are: from -1 to 86400.

      '
    type: int
  synchronous_mode_strict:
    default: true
    description: 'Enforce transactions to be committed on Primary and at least one
      more synchronous node.

      Default is true.

      '
    type: boolean
  synchronous_node_count:
    default: all
    description: 'Sets the number of synchronous nodes to be maintained in the cluster.
      Should be

      either "all", "majority" or a positive integer value.

      '
    type: string
  vacuum_autovacuum_analyze_scale_factor:
    default: 0.1
    description: 'Specifies a fraction of the table size to add to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
      when

      deciding whether to trigger a VACUUM. The default, 0.1, means 10% of table size.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 100.

      '
    type: float
  vacuum_autovacuum_analyze_threshold:
    default: 50
    description: 'Sets the minimum number of inserted, updated or deleted tuples needed
      to trigger

      an ANALYZE in any one table. Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_autovacuum_freeze_max_age:
    default: 200000000
    description: 'Maximum age (in transactions) before triggering autovacuum on a
      table to prevent

      transaction ID wraparound. Allowed values are: from 100000 to 2000000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_autovacuum_naptime:
    default: 60
    description: 'Time to sleep between autovacuum runs.

      Allowed values are: from 1 to 2147483.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_cost_delay:
    default: 2.0
    description: 'Sets cost delay value (milliseconds) that will be used in automatic
      VACUUM operations.

      Allowed values are: from -1 to 100 (-1 tells PostgreSQL to use the regular

      vacuum_cost_delay value).

      '
    type: float
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_cost_limit:
    default: -1
    description: 'Vacuum cost amount available before napping, for autovacuum.

      Allowed values are: from -1 to 10000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_insert_scale_factor:
    default: 0.2
    description: 'Number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum as a fraction of reltuples.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 100.

      '
    type: float
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_insert_threshold:
    default: 1000
    description: 'Minimum number of tuple inserts prior to vacuum, or -1 to disable
      insert vacuums.

      Allowed values are: from -1 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_scale_factor:
    default: 0.2
    description: 'Specifies a fraction of the table size to add to autovacuum_vacuum_threshold
      when

      deciding whether to trigger a VACUUM. The default, 0.2, means 20% of table size.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 100.

      '
    type: float
  vacuum_autovacuum_vacuum_threshold:
    default: 50
    description: 'Minimum number of tuple updates or deletes prior to vacuum.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2147483647.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_cost_delay:
    default: 0.0
    description: 'Vacuum cost delay in milliseconds.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 100.

      '
    type: float
  vacuum_vacuum_cost_limit:
    default: 200
    description: 'Vacuum cost amount available before napping.

      Allowed values are: from 1 to 10000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_cost_page_dirty:
    default: 20
    description: 'Vacuum cost for a page dirtied by vacuum.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 10000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_cost_page_hit:
    default: 1
    description: 'Vacuum cost for a page found in the buffer cache.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 10000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_cost_page_miss:
    default: 2
    description: 'Vacuum cost for a page not found in the buffer cache.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 10000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_failsafe_age:
    default: 1600000000
    description: 'Age at which VACUUM should trigger failsafe to avoid a wraparound
      outage.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2100000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_freeze_min_age:
    default: 50000000
    description: 'Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a table row.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 1000000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_freeze_table_age:
    default: 150000000
    description: 'Age (in transactions) at which VACUUM should scan whole table to
      freeze tuples.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2000000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_multixact_failsafe_age:
    default: 1600000000
    description: 'Multixact age at which VACUUM should trigger failsafe to avoid a
      wraparound outage.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2100000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_multixact_freeze_min_age:
    default: 5000000
    description: 'Minimum age at which VACUUM should freeze a MultiXactId in a table
      row.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 1000000000.

      '
    type: int
  vacuum_vacuum_multixact_freeze_table_age:
    default: 150000000
    description: 'Multixact age at which VACUUM should scan whole table to freeze
      tuples.

      Allowed values are: from 0 to 2000000000.

      '
    type: int
charm.metadata-yaml:
assumes:
- k8s-api
- any-of:
  - all-of:
    - juju >= 2.9.49
    - juju < 3
  - all-of:
    - juju >= 3.4.3
    - juju < 3.5
  - all-of:
    - juju >= 3.5.1
    - juju < 4
containers:
  postgresql:
    mounts:
    - location: /var/lib/postgresql/data
      storage: pgdata
    resource: postgresql-image
description: "PostgreSQL is an open-source relational database management system\n\
  built to handle a wide range of workloads. This charmed operator deploys \nand operates\
  \ PostgreSQL on Kubernetes.\n\nFor deployment on virtual machines, see [Charmed\
  \ PostgreSQL VM](https://charmhub.io/postgresql).\n\nTo learn more about how to\
  \ deploy and manage this charm, see the \n[official documentation](https://canonical-charmed-postgresql-k8s.readthedocs-hosted.com/14/).\n"
display-name: Charmed PostgreSQL K8s
docs: https://canonical-charmed-postgresql-k8s.readthedocs-hosted.com/14/
issues: https://github.com/canonical/postgresql-k8s-operator/issues
maintainers:
- Canonical Data Platform <data-platform@lists.launchpad.net>
name: postgresql-k8s
peers:
  database-peers:
    interface: postgresql_peers
  restart:
    interface: rolling_op
  upgrade:
    interface: upgrade
provides:
  database:
    interface: postgresql_client
  db:
    interface: pgsql
    optional: true
  db-admin:
    interface: pgsql
    optional: true
  grafana-dashboard:
    interface: grafana_dashboard
    optional: true
  metrics-endpoint:
    interface: prometheus_scrape
    optional: true
  replication-offer:
    interface: postgresql_async
    limit: 1
    optional: true
requires:
  certificates:
    interface: tls-certificates
    limit: 1
    optional: true
  ldap:
    interface: ldap
    limit: 1
    optional: true
  logging:
    interface: loki_push_api
    limit: 1
    optional: true
  receive-ca-cert:
    interface: certificate_transfer
    optional: true
  replication:
    interface: postgresql_async
    limit: 1
    optional: true
  s3-parameters:
    interface: s3
    limit: 1
    optional: true
  tracing:
    interface: tracing
    limit: 1
    optional: true
resources:
  postgresql-image:
    description: OCI image for PostgreSQL
    type: oci-image
    upstream-source: ghcr.io/canonical/charmed-postgresql@sha256:11db80a0b5a2fb24cee833b22bf337cbb6d6f4d3eab2328648320c020644d21e
source: https://github.com/canonical/postgresql-k8s-operator
storage:
  pgdata:
    location: /var/lib/postgresql/data
    type: filesystem
summary: Charmed PostgreSQL 14 for Kubernetes
website:
- https://ubuntu.com/data/postgresql
- https://charmhub.io/postgresql-k8s
- https://github.com/canonical/postgresql-k8s-operator
charm.name: postgresql-k8s
